en.hubeali:
From him, 
(It has been narrated) raising it from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The meat (which is) dried and the salt is sprinkled upon it, and dried in the shade’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem with eating it because the salt has changed it’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith in a marfu‘ manner who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
if meat can be dried up by salting and leaving in the shade. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not unlawful to eat it because salt has changed it.’”
